messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

The 2G network is not suitable for MMS. MMS requires at least a 3G connection. Please use the `set_network_mode_preference` action on your phone with the mode `"4g_5g_preferred"` to allow your phone to connect to faster networks like 4G or 5G.

After you change the network mode, wait a moment for the network to reconnect, then let me know what network type you see in the status bar (e.g., 4G, 5G, etc.).

I set the network mode preference to "4g_5g_preferred." My status bar now shows an excellent signal with 5G and mobile data enabled. What should I do next? Should I try sending an MMS message again now?

Please discuss the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
